streak.label: Goal streak
streak.help: A goal day = today's new words done (extra words not needed) and due reviews cleared, by your phone's date; one missed day restarts it.

pause.title: Pause {{book}}?
pause.body: No new words or reviews will be scheduled and due words will pile up; your history stays and you can resume any time. Your goal streak is not frozen.

reset.title: Reset progress in {{book}}?
reset.clears: Clears: the learning state (boxes, due dates) of words this book added, and your place in the book.
reset.keeps: Keeps: your answer history, rank points and achievements, goal streak, and words from your word list or other books (they still count as learned).

paused.note: Words keep falling due while paused; after resuming they are spread over days by your review limit.

goalMet.title: Today's goal is done
goalMet.body: Want a little more? Add a few extra new words.
